key_highlights: ASX sheds $90b in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling broad-based risk-off
Iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX earnings outlook
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressure (+30c/L)
Oil price spike pressures Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) equity story while raising inflation risk for RBA
ANZ (ANZ.AX) post-3,500-job-cut restructuring faces execution risk under new strategic plan
Housing correction deepens with no spring bounce in auctions; first-home buyer surge offers partial offset
Mining cap-raise activity (Canaccord-led) signals capital stress among junior explorers
Geopolitical escalation (Russia-Ukraine border strike, Indonesian ferry disaster) adds tail-risk premium

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active price decline; gold underperforming; junior miners raising capital under duress; Kalgoorlie Super Pit fire adds operational risk
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression; Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX (ASX small-caps) volatile; Canaccord-led cap raises dilute existing holders

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts; rate-rise fears pressure NIM expectations; housing correction threatens mortgage book quality
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX execution risk elevated; CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates but face credit-cycle headwinds from falling house prices

sectors.trend: Oil price surge on failed suppression; fuel prices +30c; Santos preservation seen as national sacrifice; airline costs spike
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from higher oil but face political/regulatory overhang; QAN.AX, DLO.AX squeezed by fuel costs and staff shortages

sectors.trend: Housing correction accelerates; auction market flat; young buyers enter but sentiment fragile; social rental build in Perth signals policy shift
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy pressure; property developers (DHG.AX, SRG.AX) under stress; consumer discretionary weak

sectors.trend: Superannuation reform debate intensifies; Amgen drug setback; AI spending scrutiny across global tech
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX relatively defensive; ASX tech (W1.AX, XRO.AX) exposed to global AI capex digestion; super fund managers face policy risk

key_themes: Rate-rise fears vs. growth scare creating a policy dilemma for RBA
Commodity divergence: oil up, iron ore down, gold weak
AUD weakness amplifying imported inflation and fuel costs
Housing market correction transitioning from correction to structural repricing
Mining sector capital stress and dilution risk
Geopolitical risk premium (Russia, Indonesia, Arctic shipping)
Superannuation system under political and structural scrutiny

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into rate hike amid growth scare
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight financials (NIM benefit) but underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance
Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore (FMG.AX, RIO.AX); favour diversified miners (BHP.AX) with copper/gold hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike driving fuel inflation and airline losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid QAN.AX, DLO.AX short-term; consider STO.AX, WDS.AX as inflation hedges with political risk discount

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing correction deepening into credit cycle
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NIM and credit-loss provisions at CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX; reduce REIT exposure
Maintain 10-15% cash/gold allocation; monitor LNG and shipping supply-chain disruption
Avoid junior miners in active cap-raise (Sunstone, Manuka, PolarX) until dilution priced in

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight integrated energy majors as oil inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Oil surge +30c fuel impact benefits STO.AX, WDS.AX revenue; political overhang on Santos creates mispricing

opportunities.recommendation: Add to large-cap diversified miners with non-iron-ore exposure
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting hurts pure-plays; BHP.AX copper/gold mix provides diversification
RBA hike pressure supports NIMs; ANZ.AX restructuring may create value once execution clarity emerges

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing correction with no auction bounce signals extended downside; credit risk building

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim pure-play iron ore and junior miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Price bloodletting + cap-raise dilution wave creates sustained downward pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Growth scare + rate uncertainty favours liquidity; AUD weakness supports local bond yields

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to test lower supports as $90b weekly loss momentum persists. Oil-driven inflation vs. growth scare creates RBA policy paralysis. AUD weakness and fuel costs suppress consumer sentiment. Expect 3-5% further downside in ^AXJO over 4-6 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook stabilises if RBA navigates soft-landing path. Housing correction may create entry points for quality REITs by Q1 2027. Iron ore stabilisation dependent on China stimulus. Superannuation reform could unlock capital flows into ASX equities. Structural shift toward energy transition and AI infrastructure remains intact.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (rate hike vs. hold)
Brent crude sustained above current spike level
watch_list: ANZ.AX, CBA.AX NIM and credit-loss guidance
STO.AX, WDS.AX production and political risk
ASX small-cap cap-raise volume (Canaccord, other brokers)
